entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.596 +/- 0.06 solar radii from Torres et al. 2008, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2008ApJ...677.1324T/abstract). Mass 1.248 +/- 0.07 solar masses from Torres et al. 2008, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2008ApJ...677.1324T/abstract). entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,860 K and log g 4.13 (u1 0.439, u2 0.272): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
